name: Shane
description: Works at JojaMart and retreats to Marnie’s coop with his chickens. Pepper poppers and a little patience go a long way.

seo.title: Shane — Joja Clerk
seo.description: Works at JojaMart and retreats to Marnie’s coop with his chickens. Pepper poppers and a little patience go a long way.

stardew.intro: Marnie’s nephew, Jas’s guardian figure, and struggling with depression. Blunt at first, deeply loyal once you earn his trust.

heartEvents.title: Coop chores
heartEvents.summary: Help him at Marnie’s chicken coop when he is in a foul mood.

heartEvents.title: Cliffside cans
heartEvents.summary: Find him drinking alone on the cliff — choose words carefully.

heartEvents.title: Gridball on TV
heartEvents.summary: Watch a game at the saloon; he loosens up if you share the moment.

heartEvents.title: Hospital scare
heartEvents.summary: A crisis at the clinic leads to Shane admitting he needs help.

heartEvents.title: Stargazing
heartEvents.summary: He invites you to the ranch at night and kisses you by the coop.

relationships.name: Marnie & Jas
relationships.note: Lives at the ranch and helps raise Jas when he is not at Joja.

relationships.name: Emily
relationships.note: Works opposite shifts at the saloon — she tries to look out for him.

trivia: Pepper poppers need hot peppers and cheese — a cozy gift once you have a kitchen.
